headline: Xbox's huge outage even blocked games on disc
summary: An extended Xbox outage affected both digital and disc-based games. Users were also unable to log in, launch apps, or find games. The outage began Sunday evening, causing widespread issues.

headline: Nanoleaf's colorful pegboard and shelf kit is half off
summary: Nanoleaf's Blocks Combo XL Smarter Kit is currently 50% off. This kit combines smart lighting panels with a low-profile shelf and pegboard. It's now available for a new low price of $99.99.

headline: Why China is giving away its best AI models
summary: China's Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 model has shaken Silicon Valley with its performance. It allegedly rivals top US AI systems at a fraction of the cost. China's strategy of open-sourcing powerful AI models intensifies global AI rivalry.

headline: YouTube Premium will include Peacock starting next year
summary: YouTube Premium subscribers will gain access to Peacock's ad-supported content. This multi-year agreement begins in 2027. Peacock shows, movies, and live sports will stream directly via the YouTube app.

headline: Where To Buy Disney Lorcana's Curator's Collection: Heroines Edition
summary: The Disney Lorcana Curator's Collection: Heroines Edition is highly sought after. It's available for purchase, often at a steep markup. This guide helps fans find where to buy the coveted set.

headline: House of the Dragon: Rhaenyra’s Worst Omen Yet Foreshadows the ‘Rot That Follows’
summary: Season 3, episode 6 of House of the Dragon features a critical moment for Rhaenyra. A director calls Rhaenyra's finger cut an 'instigating event'. This incident foreshadows significant bad things to come in the series.

headline: Are MTG x Marvel Collector Commander Decks Worth the High Price?
summary: MTG x Marvel Collector Commander Decks are back in stock at Amazon. The article questions if their high price is justified. It analyzes the value proposition for collectors and players.

headline: Save 40% Off the New 2026 Hisense U6 4K Fire TV With Hi-QLED Mini-LED Technology
summary: The new 2026 Hisense U6 4K Fire TV is on sale for 40% off. It features Hi-QLED Mini-LED technology for premium viewing. This TV is touted as a top budget option for 4K HDR movies and PS5 gaming.

headline: Wildfire now nine miles from French city of Bordeaux, mayor warns
summary: A wildfire is now nine miles from Bordeaux, prompting warnings from the mayor. Authorities are preparing for potential further evacuations. A nearby town's mayor describes the situation as 'catastrophic'.

headline: Devastating European wildfires in maps - and how they're being tackled
summary: A massive blaze near Bordeaux has consumed over 162 sq miles in four days. The Madrid region is experiencing its worst fires ever recorded. The article provides maps and details on efforts to combat the wildfires.

headline: Funeral director who left people unburied breached families' trust 'on industrial scale', court hears
summary: A funeral director is accused of breaching families' trust 'on an industrial scale'. A court heard descriptions likening the funeral parlour to a 'horror scene'. This is during the sentencing hearing of Robert Bush.

headline: Reform UK reports Zack Polanski to police over guillotine t-shirt post
summary: Reform UK has reported Zack Polanski to the police. The report concerns a post featuring a man wearing a guillotine t-shirt with the name 'Nigel'. The incident has sparked controversy and police involvement.
